before.meaningZh: 一會兒；(一段)時間；當...的時候；雖然
before.meaningEn: (conj.) during the time that something happens; whereas, or although; (n.) a period of time; (v., while away) to spend time pleasantly.
before.usagePattern: while + S + V; while + V-ing (reduced clause); for a while; while away + time
before.sourceNote: 高中英文參考詞彙表（111學年度起適用，大考中心）
before.usagePatternZh: 當……時／然而／雖然 + 子句；簡化子句可接動名詞；一會兒；消磨時間
